# Coding agent > Desktop coding workspace with project tasks, a focused conversation, and a persistent controlled composer. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `coding-agent-block` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/coding-agent-block.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/coding-agent-block.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `app-shell` - `avatar` - `button` - `chat-layout` - `collapsible` - `core` - `empty` - `item` - `sidebar` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/blocks/coding-agent`: `CodingAgentBlock`, `CodingAgentConversation`, `CodingAgentEmptyState`, types `CodingAgentNavigationItem`, `CodingAgentTask`, `CodingAgentProject`, `CodingAgentBlockProps`, `CodingAgentConversationProps`, `CodingAgentSuggestion`, `CodingAgentEmptyStateProps` ## Composition ### Rendered workspace shell ```tsx navigation projects and tasks task header children prop rendered turns or empty content composer prop ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client";
